attributes.name: Ralph Robins
attributes.summary:
Sir Ralph spent almost his entire career at Rolls-Royce, culminating in a 20-year term on the company's board where he served as both CEO and chairman.

Sir Ralph's other roles have included chairing Cable & Wireless, and serving as a director of Standard Chartered and Schroders. Sir Ralph is currently chairman of Gama Aviation, a director of Marshall of Cambridge, and a member of the advisory board of Seabury.
